title: New Year’s Portfolio Cleaning
summary: Liquidity caution and healthcare thesis revisions.
coverage_note: Read all macro, bitcoin, portfolio-change rationale, healthcare and gold sections. Historical quotations retain original horizons; neutral BMY exit is not recast as a bearish forecast. Source contains an edit dated 1/7/2024 within a January 2025 article, an apparent year error and sign of later editing.

framework_lessons: Revise conviction when cash-flow evidence changes.
assessment: The stronger 2025 equity-caution call was supported by lower return, higher realized volatility and a deeper drawdown. The Fed liquidity arithmetic overstated balance-sheet shrinkage, and midyear QT timing was early. CVS operating recovery coexisted with acquisition impairment; its verdict must remain mixed. The BMY sale expressed lost conviction, not an outperformance forecast.
